add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../dmusic)

spec2def(dmstyle.dll dmstyle.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(dmstyle registry dmstyle.idl)

# dmstyle.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dmstyle-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dmstyle_shims OBJECT auditiontrack.c chordtrack.c commandtrack.c dmstyle_main.c dmutils.c motiftrack.c mutetrack.c style.c styletrack.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmusic/dmobject.c)
target_link_libraries(dmstyle_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libole32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dmstyle_shims)
add_dependencies(dmstyle_shims wineheaders)
set(DMSTYLE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dmstyle/dmstyle_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dmstyle dmstyle-cargo dmstyle.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dmstyle_shims psdk dmstyle_r ${DMSTYLE_REUSED} uuid_sources)
